title: "Research | Fallah Nyumah"
description: "Climate-resilient oil palm and rubber plantations in Liberia: process-based modelling, economic assessment, life-cycle assessment, and decision support."

<div class="site-wrap inner-page">
 <header class="page-intro"><p class="eyebrow">RESEARCH PROGRAM</p><h1>Climate-resilient<br><em>plantation landscapes.</em></h1><p class="page-intro-lede">Towards sustainable oil palm and rubber plantations in Liberia through integrated ecological, economic, and decision-science perspectives.</p></header>
 <section class="research-highlight"><div><span class="tiny-label">DOCTORAL RESEARCH</span><h2>Towards Sustainable Oil Palm and Rubber Plantations in Liberia: Integrating Social, Ecological, and Economic Values</h2></div><p>The central question: How can oil palm and rubber management improve productivity and climate resilience while accounting for long-term carbon outcomes and economic trade-offs?</p></section>
 <section class="content-section" id="process-based-modelling"><div class="section-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">STREAM 01</p><h2>Process-based modelling</h2></div><span class="section-num">01 / 03</span></div><div class="editorial-split"><p class="larger-copy">How do plantations grow, allocate biomass, respond to water and climate stress, and store carbon over a rotation?</p><div><p>I use the <strong>3PG-RubPalm</strong> research framework to simulate plantation growth, harvested yield, water balance, biomass allocation, and carbon dynamics for oil palm and rubber under Liberian conditions.</p><p>Simulation scenarios explore climate pathways, site characteristics, and management choices. Model evaluation and uncertainty assessment help distinguish well-supported findings from limitations.</p><a class="text-link" href="tools.html">3PG-RubPalm project <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></div></section>
 <section class="content-section" id="climate-risk-and-carbon"><div class="section-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">STREAM 02</p><h2>Climate risk &amp; carbon</h2></div><span class="section-num">02 / 03</span></div><div class="editorial-split"><p class="larger-copy">Which climate drivers affect plantation productivity, and what do those changes mean for yield risk and carbon pathways?</p><div><p>My research examines how changes in temperature, rainfall, humidity, solar radiation, wind, and atmospheric CO₂ affect modelled plantation processes.</p><p>This work also considers carbon stored in biomass, soil, and plantation residues. Climate scenario results are interpreted as model-based projections, not observed future outcomes.</p><a class="text-link" href="publications.html">Research manuscripts <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></div></section>
 <section class="content-section" id="assessment-and-decision-support"><div class="section-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">STREAM 03</p><h2>Assessment &amp; decision support</h2></div><span class="section-num">03 / 03</span></div><div class="editorial-split"><p class="larger-copy">How can biological, economic, and environmental evidence support actionable plantation decisions?</p><div><p>Techno-economic analysis evaluates investment performance and management costs, while life-cycle assessment examines greenhouse-gas burdens and emission intensity.</p><p>An integrated decision-support approach is being developed to compare alternative management and climate-adaptation pathways, including the distribution of benefits and trade-offs across criteria.</p><a class="text-link" href="tools.html">Decision tools <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></div></div></section>
 <section class="research-sites"><div class="section-heading"><div><p class="eyebrow">STUDY CONTEXT</p><h2>Grounded in Liberia</h2></div></div><p>My research focuses on plantation systems in Liberia, including oil palm operations in Sinoe County and rubber cultivation in Margibi County. Plantation case studies provide a context for investigating productivity, carbon dynamics, climate sensitivity, and management options.</p><div class="site-pair"><div><span class="tiny-label">OIL PALM</span><h3>Butaw area, Sinoe County</h3><p>Oil palm plantation modelling and sustainability assessment.</p></div><div><span class="tiny-label">RUBBER</span><h3>Harbel area, Margibi County</h3><p>Rubber plantation modelling and sustainability assessment.</p></div></div><p class="small-note">Specific research-site boundaries, management records, and proprietary datasets are not published on this website.</p></section>
 <section class="closing-cta"><div><p class="eyebrow">METHODOLOGY</p><h2>Research that connects models and decisions.</h2><p>Browse the developing models, greenhouse-gas tools, and decision-support applications.</p></div><a class="btn-primary-custom" href="tools.html">View research tools <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span></a></section>
